entries.text: Worlds now stay where you drop them, including on top of each other.
Load the board faster by hiding card text that is too small to read when zoomed out.
Speed up the first paint of the board on load.
Track high-signal board actions as Hobby Web Analytics pageviews.
Make shared parent trunk and bus segments clickable for multi-child links.
Remove Export PNG from the overflow menu.
Keep link chips on real ink, harden pedigree stems, and improve JSON load/autosave.
Add save import, minimap, and tile packing, and keep world frames from overlapping.
Persist age, single, and bloodline filters in saved JSON so load restores the same Filters view.
Add gender to the sim editor and randomize it for new sims.
Regroup the app bar into do / see / find so filters share one control.
Add household age-up, undo, and bloodline dim, and log those events with deaths and editor life-stage changes.
Add infant-from-couple, keep popups on-screen, and make the connection log easier to scan.
Add a connection log and keep tags still when linking or moving households.
Add a contact email to the overflow menu.
Fix Other-world family links against The Sims Wiki.
Add phone chrome, gestures, and viewport-aware new-sim placement.
Install Vercel Web Analytics.
Update repo and production URLs after GitHub rename.
Add MIT license, credits UI, and Family Trees branding.
Keep cross-household connection lines clear of unrelated tags.
Fix Other world layout: 7-column grid with tight linked clusters.
Add dynamic household layout and fix pedigree placement and routing.
Stop child connectors doubling back when the child sits close below a union.
Collapse the header and toolbar into a single app bar.
Keep union connector detours local instead of spanning both tags.
Stop the board refitting mid-drag.
Force union connectors to enter tags and pills from the sides.
Restore relationship pill rendering and clear the stale connect rubber band.
Fix the board not fitting the window on load, and tidy where the legend and hint sit.
Fix the board not filling the whole window.
Fix Vercel build: pin Node 22 and configure pnpm install via corepack.
First version of the Family Trees Whiteboard.
